Error.title: Bots: Jev can't be reached
Error.lead: {bot} could not get Jev's judgment for a decision ({kind}). The bot is waiting.
Error.hint: Start the Jev relay (tools/jev-proxy/start-jev-relay.command) or check the relay URL in the settings, then retry. Built-in judgment plays on without Jev; those decisions are marked in the Bot Log.
Error.notBot: That faction isn't played by a bot.
Error.notPlacement: Starting forces can only be placed while the war is in its placement stage.

LLM.title: Bots: a chat-model call failed
LLM.titleSpend: Bots: the chat-model spending cap is reached
LLM.lead: {bot} could not get a decision ({kind}) from the chat model {model}. The bot is waiting.
LLM.hint: Check the chat-model API URL and key in the Bot Manager (or start the relay, if the URL points at it), then retry. Built-in judgment plays on without the chat model; those decisions are marked in the Bot Log.
LLM.hintSpend: This war's chat-model spending reached the cap (${spent} of ${limit}). Raise the cap (Bot Manager, or the setting "Chat-model spending cap") and retry, or play on with built-in judgment.
LLM.hintBlocked: Choose another model for this bot (or another default model) in the Bot Manager, then retry. The model list there shows only the models your key's organisation allows.
LLM.hintAuth: The API rejected the key. Paste a valid key in the Bot Manager (Chat models), then retry.
LLM.hintBadOutput: The model answered twice without a usable answer. Retry, choose a stronger model for this bot, or play this decision with built-in judgment.

Notify.stalled: Bot {faction} could not finish its turn. Use game.risklegacy.bots.playTurn() to retry, or finish the turn by hand.
Notify.endRefused: The game refused to end {faction}'s turn.
